description: This file contains Bash shell scripts used for managing IMX platform system upgrades, including functions for handling root partitions, mounting boot partitions, copying configurations, performing system upgrades, and moving configuration files.

methods.name: rootpartuuid
methods.description: Extracts the root partition UUID from the kernel command line.

methods.name: bootdev_from_uuid
methods.description: Gets the device name of the boot device based on the root partition UUID.

methods.name: bootpart_from_uuid
methods.description: Returns the boot partition device name associated with the UUID.

methods.name: rootpart_from_uuid
methods.description: Returns the root partition device name associated with the UUID.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_mount_boot
methods.description: Mounts the boot partition to /boot if not already mounted.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration to the boot partition.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs system upgrade by extracting kernel and root filesystem images.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Pre-upgrade steps like resetting JFFS2 and unmounting overlay.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_move_config
methods.description: Moves backup configuration files from the boot partition to root.
